questions.q: An object has a mass of 2.0 kg. What is its weight on Earth? (g = 9.8 N/kg)
questions.why: W = mg = 2.0 × 9.8 = 19.6 N; weight is a force, measured in newtons.

questions.q: A 4.0 kg box is pushed with a force of 20 N against a friction force of 8.0 N. What is its acceleration?
questions.why: Resultant force = 20 − 8.0 = 12 N, so a = F ÷ m = 12 ÷ 4.0 = 3.0 m/s².
